working_estimate.threshold_claim: Does not support a broad expected-error-below-two claim. The mathematical subtotal must not substitute for the broader scope.

attribution.event_semantics: Each event means at least one error in the family; its conditional mean is the union of distinct affected scored pairs, possibly from multiple related omissions. Do not multiply by an additional unknown number of papers.
attribution.correlation: No independence assumption. One missed theorem can affect disjoint retained and new pairs; those pair counts add while event probabilities remain correlated. Shared operational defects are charged once.
attribution.numeric_limit: This is an intended attribution and sensitivity framework, not a fully elicited exact joint probability distribution.

followups.title: Quantum/counting upper-bound source chains
followups.check: Read complete primary chains through intermediate classes and pre-cutoff 2025–2026 updates; explicitly record failed total/promise, nonnegative-witness, postselection and advice transfers.
followups.mechanism: An old intermediate-class theorem can resolve several labels without naming the roster endpoints in its title.
followups.success_criterion: Exact theorem locators and valid/invalid implication derivations for this bounded interface set; no openness certification from missing search hits.

followups.title: End-to-end QSZK operational equivalence
exact_interfaces: Statistical.lean measurementProbability and reduced density matrices
far/close versus one-half trace norm, including attained boundaries
total-language QSD reductions in both directions
followups.check: Derive the exact finite matrix formulas and measurement optimum, then match both directions of the cited completeness theorem to the implemented sampler/generator convention.
followups.mechanism: Current local environment invariants do not establish the full bridge; one mismatch can affect a family of model-bound labels without invalidating any accepted source theorem.
followups.success_criterion: Complete formula-level equivalence dossier or compiled lemmas with explicit remaining assumptions.

followups.title: ETR finite encoding and Boolean-part boundary
exact_interfaces: RealSyntax accepted binary words versus a primary finite ETR encoding
unary metadata, binary coefficients, Boolean negation, malformed inputs and quadratic auxiliary variables
BP(P_R^0) versus BP(NP_R^0), PosSLP and complex feasibility
followups.check: Give explicit polynomial reductions both ways and inspect any proposed counting upper-bound transfer under its exact real-machine and encoding hypotheses.
followups.mechanism: Local parser invariants do not establish full polynomial equivalence; deterministic real computation and nondeterministic real feasibility must not be conflated.
followups.success_criterion: Both finite-encoding reductions with polynomial size/time accounting and a source-backed acceptance/rejection of the counting transfer.

limitations: Existing proofs are trusted under the user waiver; this review still checks their hypotheses match exact operational definitions.
Source reviews share ancestry and should not be treated as statistically independent repeated evidence.
Sensitivity ranges are judgmental stress cases with no empirical calibration.
Roster demotion changes coverage and weight, not truth; direct independence credit does not propagate.
Root owns the final release-wide assessment and any historical registry decision.
